items.title: Mahalia Jackson Interview, 1962-05-02
items.q: They might do it to Louis Armstrong or some of the other people, but not to Mahaya.

ctx.x: Well, I hope you get a chance to try it. How do you explain, for instance, prejudice in the world when it seems that people everywhere love to hear you sing?

Well, there are a few people that you would say that is just mentally sick because this mental sickness is just like any other disease. And that's why prejudice come in because I go down south and even many of the white people there come in and I never question about where will the white people sit and where will the color because the gospel is too great for that kind of question to come. They might do it to Louis Armstrong or some of the other people, but not to Mahaya. When they come to hear me, they come in to…
Well, Mahaya, could you sort of give us a sum up your philosophy of life just briefly? Do you have one thing?
